name: Toaster
summary: Two-slot kitchen toaster with a lever; anim popup makes the toast slices jump up out of the slots.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the toaster stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 330 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: popup = toast slices jump up out of the slots and sink back

author: krakujs
